script_drafts.title: Driver cleanup moment schema script

scenes.visual: Show a driver opening the car door and noticing small debris.
scenes.action: Frame the mess as a familiar car interior cleanup moment.
scenes.voiceover: You notice the mess right when you are about to leave.

scenes.visual: Show a clean interior after the cleanup context is demonstrated.
scenes.action: Avoid naming unverified suction, wattage, runtime, or noise claims.
scenes.voiceover: Keep every product claim tied to verified facts before publishing.
